about_the_game:
The day began like any other… but something is definitely wrong. You’re trapped in an infinitely repeating office labyrinth, and the only way out is to find "Office 8".

Gameplay: Explore the unsettling and surreal corridors of what feels like a limitless office space. Trust only your eyes and ears. Pay attention to the details, because anomalies are your key to survival! Each room presents a new challenge where visual and auditory inconsistencies can be hidden in the most unexpected places.

Your choices are the key to progress. If everything seems normal and familiar, confidently proceed through the door marked with the green exit sign. But if something feels suspicious, if you see or hear a deviation from the norm, choose the door with the red sign. Be careful: some anomalies are dangerous! One wrong choice, and your journey to freedom starts all over again.

Careful observation, the ability to analyze details, and rapid adaptation to the changing environment are what will help you survive and find your way out of this nightmare.

Story: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a mysterious office belonging to the «IntegraSignal» telecommunications conglomerate and uncover the secret of your imprisonment. What is hidden behind the walls of "Office 8"? To understand what’s really happening, you’ll have to navigate through all the distorted levels of this endless labyrinth.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of violence and depictions of self-harm.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: intel Core i7 4770
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: "Office 8" is a psychological walking simulator exploring the unsettling nature of liminal office spaces. Pay close attention — your sanity depends on it.
